vulkan.$comment: On Android vulkan-loader is not built: the loader is the OS's libvulkan (NDK link library, never a built port). directx-dxc is a host tool for the test-shader step on every configuration that builds tests; it must not set platform:windows, because vcpkg evaluates that expression against the target triplet and would drop the host tool from the Android closure.

overrides.$comment: vulkan-headers, vulkan-loader and vulkan-memory-allocator are a matched SDK set and must move together: the loader's generated VulkanLoaderConfig.cmake hard-references the Vulkan::Headers target of its own release, so pinning one and leaving the others on a bare version>= lets a baseline move break the configure in whichever direction the unpinned side drifts (observed once already, headers pinned / loader floating -- see docs/spikes/M4-phase2a-test-harness.md Â§4b).
overrides.name: vulkan-headers

$comment-android: The !android gates keep the engine's dependencies out of the Android closure. They lift together with trinity/CMakeLists.txt's ANDROID early-return, in the second half, and on a POSIX host -- those three are one decision, not three. M6 Task 12 measured why: python3 cannot cross-build for android from a Windows host (CPython's pybuilddir.txt step runs sysconfig --generate-posix-vars, which a Windows build python cannot satisfy), and a POSIX-built artifact cannot be restored on Windows either, because vcpkg's ABI hash embeds host identity by design -- four measured causes in docs/spikes/artifacts/m6-python3-abi-probe-20260901.txt. carbon-blue pulls python3, so ungating it makes the arm64-android tree unconfigurable on Windows, which is the host every device run in M6's first half was driven from. The spec asked for the gates and the early-return to be split into two independent facts; the probe result couples them again, and this comment says so rather than pretending otherwise. The port set itself IS proven for arm64-android -- 137/137 installed, 114 android packages, zero failures, on the POSIX host, logged in docs/spikes/artifacts/m6-fullset-vcpkg-20260901.txt with the manifest recipe beside it. amd-fidelityfx-cas and amd-fidelityfx-cacao are the two gates that never lift: upscaling is a non-goal (M12-if-ever, mobile-only, the Vulkan backend keeps the stub) and both are Windows-shader-stack ports.
